resources.string: A little structure for the things that matter. Choose how you would like to begin.
As a guest, your progress is saved only on this device by Guider. It can be lost if you uninstall the app, clear its data, or lose your phone. You can sign in later in Settings.
Google sign-in connects your account through Firebase. Cloud backup is not available yet, so progress stays on this device even when you sign in.
Google sign-in is not configured in this build yet. You can continue as a guest.
Automatically follow your phone’s light or dark mode
Cloud sync and account-specific progress are not enabled yet. Signing in or out does not upload, delete, or separate the progress on this device.
You will return to the welcome screen. Your local progress stays on this device and remains available in guest mode or with another account.
Google sign-in needs Firebase configuration. Add app/google-services.json and check FIREBASE_SETUP.md. Guest mode is still available.
Could not connect. Check your internet connection and try again.
No Google account was available. Add an account to your phone and try again, or continue as a guest.
Google sign-in is unavailable on this device. Check that Google Play services is installed and up to date, or continue as a guest.
Could not sign in with Google. Try again. If this continues, check the Firebase Google provider, web client ID, and this build’s signing certificate.
Could not finish clearing the Google account picker. Check your account status and try again if you are still signed in.
Could not save your preferences on this device. Please try again.
